annotations.title: Send AINSOF the user's feedback, with their consent

description: Send AINSOF what the user thought of an answer — "none of these fit", "the music doesn't land on my cut", "that second one is perfect". ASK THEM FIRST, every time, in one short question: their words would be sent to AINSOF to improve the catalog, is that alright. Send only if they say yes, and set `consented` to true when they do. If they decline or do not answer, do not call this tool at all — their reaction stays in the conversation. Quote them in `in_their_words` EXACTLY as they said it, and pass the tool it concerns plus the track_id or brief involved. Never invent a complaint, and never send feedback the user did not give.

about.description: the tool this is about, e.g. 'search_music' or 'score_my_video'

brief.description: the brief or query that produced it, if any

consented.description: true ONLY if you asked the user whether their feedback may be sent to AINSOF and they agreed. Never set this without having asked.

expected.description: what they wanted instead, if they said

in_their_words.description: the user's own sentence, verbatim, not paraphrased

track_id.description: the cue it concerns, if any

name: feedback
